capabilities.label: Chrome side panel
capabilities.summary: Manifest V3 side panel with Capture, Recent, Following and This page modes.
capabilities.blocker: Browser E2E gate is still open.

capabilities.label: Passage, screenshot and media capture
capabilities.summary: Text-quote anchors, visible-tab screenshots and bounded media ranges share one capture model.
capabilities.blocker: Browser E2E gate is still open.

capabilities.label: Hosted 240p clips
capabilities.summary: The server transcodes, probes and hosts bounded excerpts rather than embedding a third-party player.

capabilities.label: 90-second server limit
capabilities.summary: The API, transcoder and output probe enforce the same maximum duration.

capabilities.label: Text and audio commentary
capabilities.summary: Annotations accept written notes or staged recorded audio commentary.
capabilities.blocker: Browser E2E gate is still open.

capabilities.label: Original-source deep links
capabilities.summary: Every annotation preserves a source link and anchors to the passage or media time when possible.

capabilities.label: Shareable landing pages
capabilities.summary: Each annotation has a server-rendered permalink, social metadata and generated share card.

capabilities.label: Feed, follows and responses
capabilities.summary: Public discovery, profiles, source hubs, follows, likes and responses form the social proof loop.

capabilities.label: Google and X sign-in
capabilities.summary: Provider availability is reported from the running deployment, never assumed by the UI.
capabilities.blocker: Provider credentials are verified at runtime.

capabilities.label: Rights claims and takedowns
capabilities.summary: Claims persist, deduplicate and can resolve into a tombstone with hosted assets removed.

capabilities.label: Video, podcasts and articles
capabilities.summary: One annotation model covers YouTube, direct media, podcast enclosures and article passages.
